facts.title: Learn Herbalism
facts.note: No skill or level needed; teaches to skill 75. Junior trainers teach only this rank. Peacebloom and Silverleaf at skill 1.

facts.title: Journeyman Herbalism at skill 50
facts.note: No level requirement for any Herbalism rank: Journeyman at 50, Expert at 125, Artisan at 200, all from the same trainers.
